Apple Unveils New iPhone 18 Pro and MacBook Models

Apple has launched its latest iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models, featuring significant camera upgrades, including a new f/1.48 aperture lens. The company also introduced new MacBook models powered by the M6 chip, showcasing improved benchmark performance. These new devices are now available on shelves in various markets, including the UAE. Alongside hardware updates, Apple is preparing to release iOS 27, which will bring changes to the operating system.
